title: Looking for Ukrainian Character Designer for Custom Vampire Outfit

That’s all 🙏 I think it’s a little too specific. I’ve seen gorgeous character designers but I’m just looking for someone super specific! (Related posts confirm has money and is actively seeking to commission.) Contact via reply/DM.
